I saved 25 November as the next renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. in the shared brain, with Ilse's #north-team message as the source. Then I confirmed it to Ilse in a thread reply.

There was no earlier renewal date stored for the account, so nothing was overwritten. Search is running in a limited keyword-only mode, though, so an older note worded differently could have been missed.

Ilse didn't give a year. Her message was sent on 14 October 2026, so I recorded it as 25 November 2026. That's my assumption, not something she said.
